sections.heading: The justice system
sections.body:
- *la justice civile* — disputes between people (*un litige*: a dispute): divorce, contracts, inheritance.
- *la justice pénale* — offences against society: *une contravention* (a minor offence, e.g. parking), *un délit* (an offence, e.g. theft), *un crime* (a serious crime, e.g. murder), tried by *la cour d'assises* with a jury.
- people: *le juge*, *le procureur* (the public prosecutor), *l'avocat / l'avocate* (the lawyer), *l'accusé(e)* / *le prévenu* (the defendant), *la victime*, *le témoin* (the witness), *les jurés* (jurors).

sections.heading: A trial
sections.body: *porter plainte* (to press charges) — *une enquête* — *être mis en examen* (to be formally investigated; *mettre en examen* is not "to examine") — *le procès* (the trial) — *plaider coupable / non coupable* (to plead guilty / not guilty) — *témoigner* (to testify) — *le verdict* — *être condamné à* (to be sentenced to) — *être acquitté* (to be acquitted) — *faire appel* (to appeal) — *la peine* (the sentence): *une amende* (a fine), *une peine de prison avec sursis* (a suspended sentence).

sections.heading: Principles of law
sections.body: *la présomption d'innocence* — *nul n'est censé ignorer la loi* (ignorance of the law is no excuse) — *l'État de droit* (the rule of law) — *les droits de l'homme* — *l'égalité devant la loi* — *le secret de l'instruction* (confidentiality of the investigation) — *la peine de mort* (abolished in France in 1981).

sections.heading: Legal language
sections.body: Legal French is formal and precise: *Il est interdit de…* — *Tout contrevenant sera poursuivi.* (Anyone breaking this rule will be prosecuted.) — *en vertu de l'article 3* (under article 3) — *sous peine de* (on pain of) — *le cas échéant* (where applicable).

examples: Le litige oppose deux voisins.
The dispute is between two neighbours.
Le vol est un délit, le meurtre est un crime.
Theft is an offence, murder is a crime.
Elle a porté plainte contre son employeur.
She pressed charges against her employer.
Le suspect a été mis en examen.
The suspect has been formally placed under investigation.
Le procès s'ouvrira lundi.
The trial will open on Monday.
L'accusé a plaidé non coupable.
The defendant pleaded not guilty.
Trois témoins ont témoigné devant la cour.
Three witnesses testified before the court.
Il a été condamné à deux ans de prison avec sursis.
He was given a two-year suspended prison sentence.
Faute de preuves, l'accusée a été acquittée.
For lack of evidence, the defendant was acquitted.
Son avocat a décidé de faire appel.
His lawyer decided to appeal.
Elle a payé une amende de cent euros.
She paid a fine of a hundred euros.
Tout accusé bénéficie de la présomption d'innocence.
Every defendant enjoys the presumption of innocence.
La peine de mort a été abolie en France en 1981.
The death penalty was abolished in France in 1981.
Le cas échéant, le contrat pourra être modifié.
Where applicable, the contract may be amended.
